title: Genesis 23:5-7 — the sons of Heth call Abraham a mighty prince
summary: Genesis 23:5-7: the sons of Heth tell Abraham he is a mighty prince among them and offer him the choicest of their graves; Abraham bows to the people of the land.

text.text: 5 The sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
6 “Hear us, my lord, you are a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our graves; none of us will refuse you his grave for burying your dead.”
7 So Abraham rose and bowed to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
